passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled act creates IC 20-33-7.5 Sec. 2, a written-notification duty on every such request; Sec. 3-4 add no staff safety exception.
Senate roll call 345 on HB 1608 final passage, 3rd reading; Raatz recorded in the Yea column.
Bill details page lists Raatz as a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023).
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Stacey Donato, Sen. Jeff Raatz, Sen. Gary Byrne.

rows.reasoning: Raatz was a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023) and voted Yea at final passage. The enacted chapter, IC 20-33-7.5 Sec. 2, requires a school to notify a parent in writing of every student request to change name, pronoun, title, or identifying word, with no exception elsewhere in the chapter for a staff belief of danger, matching the rung text 'Require staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school.'
